title: Interception of Login Credentials
description: Teacher's login credentials transmitted to the Grades Portal Web App could be intercepted if not encrypted, leading to unauthorized access.
assumptions: Assumes no TLS/SSL encryption is used for the login request.

title: Weak Authentication Mechanism
description: Inadequate authentication controls in the Grades Portal Web App may allow unauthorized users to impersonate a teacher and access submission queues.
assumptions: Assumes authentication relies on weak credentials or lacks multi-factor authentication.

title: Excessive Data Access to Submissions
description: The Grades Portal Web App may grant teachers access to submission queues beyond their assigned courses, exposing student data unnecessarily.
assumptions: Assumes access controls do not strictly limit data visibility to the teacher's courses.
uncertainty_note: Depends on implementation of role-based access controls.

title: Lack of Transparency in Data Processing
description: Teachers may be unaware that their access to submission queues is logged or monitored, violating transparency principles.
assumptions: Assumes no clear notification or consent mechanism for logging teacher activities.
